projectConfig.title: Pull-request review
projectConfig.why: /pr-review pushes fixes and posts replies on a real PR, so it must never guess which repo a PR belongs to, where its checkout is, or which gates prove a fix — all of that is declared here.

schema.description: Pull-request review contract consumed by review-pack. Required for /pr-review. This fragment is mirrored in plugins/review-pack/requirements.json, which the dashboard renders the config form from; scripts/check-plugin-requirements.sh fails CI when the two drift, so change both in one commit.

owner.description: GitHub org or user that owns the repos, e.g. <org>

worktreeRoot.description: Directory for throwaway review worktrees. Default: pr-review/ under AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT, else TMPDIR.

knowledge.description: Optional path (relative to the project root) of a markdown file with project-specific verification heuristics and known CI flake signatures; /pr-review reads it in full.

repos.description: One entry per reviewable repo, keyed by the GitHub repo name.

path.description: Absolute path of the local main checkout (never modified; worktrees are cut from it).

setup.description: Commands run inside a fresh worktree before anything else (submodules, dependency install).

gates.description: Commands that must all pass before a fix is pushed or a reply is posted.

reviewSkills.description: Skills to load before reviewing a diff in this repo.

notes.description: Free-text quirks a reviewer must know for this repo.
